title: Visual standout via color or contrast and memory interaction
statement:
Items that stand out visually from their peers (via distinct color or high contrast) are significantly more likely to be remembered and interacted with.

Options:
- Maximum Isolation: Complementary Color (fits: primary cta, buy buttons)
- Brand-aligned Isolation: Monochromatic Bold (fits: secondary actions, form submissions)
- Negative Isolation: Ghost / Outline (fits: cancel actions, tertiary links)
appliesWhen: Applies to: landing pages, checkout flows. Audience: general.
